description: A photograph depicting a coastal lagoon under a blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground on the left, there are exposed muddy or sandy flats at the edge of the water, with larger rocks and low-lying vegetation on the bank. To the right, a paved pedestrian pathway runs along the coastline, with two people visible walking in the distance. Beyond the pathway, buildings of a settlement are visible, extending towards a distant hilly or mountainous landscape. The image is sourced from "©European Union, 2012" and attributed to "LUCAS" (Land Use/Cover Area frame Survey).
